services.desc: Half-day sportfishing charters from Key Largo targeting sailfish, mahi, tuna, wahoo and reef species.

services.name: ¾ Day Trip
services.desc: Duration 6 Hours and 30 Minutes About In Key Largo, fish for Sailfish, Mahi Mahi, Tuna and Wahoo. The drop is only about 5-6 miles offshore, so we can get to deep waters quickly and have an exciting offshore fishing trip. We could incorporate patch/reef fishing, which is perfect for families. services.name: Full Day Trip
services.desc: Duration 8 Hours About We could travel up to 25 miles offshore of Key Largo in the Summer to fish for Mahi Mahi. In the Winter, our fishing charters are usually closer to shore, where we will target Sailfish, Mahi Mahi, Wahoo and Tuna. We might also incorporate patch and reef fishing for Grouper, Snapper and King Mackerel if desired. Includes Rod Reels & Tackle Live Bait Lures Catch Cleaning & Filleting First Mate Fishing License Not Included Gratuity It is customary to tip
